title: Japanese Curry Roux

ingredientGroups.title: Spice mix
items: 1 dried shiitake mushroom, broken into pieces
1 (1-inch) strip dried kombu, cut into pieces
1 tsp cayenne pepper, or more to taste

steps: Toast cinnamon, bay leaf, mustard, coriander, fennel, cumin, fenugreek, cloves and cardamom over medium heat, stirring until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Transfer to a spice grinder.
Add mushroom, kombu and peppercorns; grind at high speed for 30 seconds, shaking the grinder as needed. Transfer to a bowl and add orange zest, turmeric, ginger, salt, paprika and cayenne.

Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Lower to medium-low, gradually whisk in flour and cook, stirring constantly, until light brown, 15–20 minutes. Turn off heat and stir in the spice mix.
Divide among three mini loaf pans, about ¾ cup each, or spread on a parchment-lined quarter sheet tray. Cool briefly, then refrigerate until firm.
Unmold and cut each loaf into 9 cubes, or cut the sheet into 27 pieces. Wrap tightly. The source says refrigerate about a month or freeze 3 months.
